apps.localizedDescription:
TEKKEN – unique fighting game now for iOS devices with numerous characters. In the game you will find more than 100 unique characters, each of which has a unique style of combat and weapons. Choose your favorite game mode and start the fight, against strong opponents applying 20 special punches. In the course of the game, you will discover new techniques that you will master and apply against the opponent. Challenge the real players from around the world and fight them in the arena. Collect your invincible team and collect all the awards, participating in various tournaments and winning them. Become the best fighter in this game and defeat all your rivals.

English: No
Compatible: iPhone, iPad, iPod touch.
